title: Redact deep command journal secrets
summary: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W01-004 by making command-journal evidence inspect structured containers before depth truncation and by defensively redacting legacy stringified credential-shaped mappings.
reason: The current recursion cap stringifies uninspected mappings and lists, allowing deep password, token, join_blob, secret, api_key, or authorization values to reach JSON history, SQLite mirrors, and operator-visible command evidence in plaintext.
affected_areas: JSON and SQLite command evidence persistence
generated source summaries and change-control evidence
behavior_before: At the depth cap, structured values are converted with str before sensitive keys are inspected, and stringified mapping syntax is not redacted.
behavior_after: Mappings and lists are inspected before depth enforcement, over-depth containers use a constant sentinel or key-aware bounded shape, sensitive aliases are always redacted, and legacy stringified credential-shaped values are defensively sanitized before persistence or display.
tests_added: Depth 3-6 mapping/list combinations for every sensitive alias
Synthetic fake-secret absence in JSON and SQLite persistence
Useful nonsecret boundary evidence and constant truncation sentinel coverage
